inputThis:
$:set -euo pipefail
test -f AGENTS.md
if test -f README.md; then cat README.md >/dev/null; fi
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/issues/3 --jq .body >/dev/null
test ! -e .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
test ! -e config/file-metadata.json
mkdir -p .devcontainer
cat > .devcontainer/devcontainer.json <<'USER_REQUESTED_DEVCONTAINER_EOF'
{
  "name": "MCP Remote Server Space",
  "features": {
    "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node:1": {
      "version": "lts"
    }
  },
  "forwardPorts":,
  "portsAttributes": {
    "3000": {
      "label": "MCP SSE Server",
      "onAutoForward": "silent",
      "elevationRequired": false
    }
  },
  "postCreateCommand": "npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything",
  "waitFor": "postCreateCommand"
}
USER_REQUESTED_DEVCONTAINER_EOF
printf 'FILE_BYTES '; wc -c < .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
printf 'INVALID_FORWARD_PORTS_ENTRY '; grep -F '"forwardPorts":,' .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
git add -- .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
git diff --cached --check
gh auth setup-git
git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
git commit -m 'Add user-provided devcontainer configuration verbatim'
pushed=0
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
 git fetch origin main -q
 git rebase origin/main -q
 if git push origin HEAD:main; then pushed=1; break; fi
done
test "$pushed" -eq 1
printf 'PUBLISHED_COMMIT '; git rev-parse HEAD
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
